---
name: architecture-design
description: Use when designing marketplace boundaries, integrations, dependencies, data ownership, alternatives, or ADRs.
---

Read `/AGENTS.md`, the relevant spec, architecture rules, and related ADRs. Inspect only the focused code path. Map boundaries, data/control flow, dependencies, failure modes, compatibility impact, and alternatives. Identify whether an ADR and user approval are required.

Quality check: the design names what is deliberately out of scope and how the proposal can be tested.
